title: Conditional denominator and label-precedence audit of the archived PTATO Figure2 code
status: Original internal code audit using previously acquired sources; actual affected row counts remain unknown
evidence_class: Standard set and averaging identities plus two declared constructed examples; no new biological observations, mathematical priority or demonstrated source-result error

metadata.status: Authenticated in R24, not newly acquired here

assumptions: Use one retained reference SNV row per sample and exact variant key, after the declared predecessor/autosome/VAF/chr17 rules.
First audit duplicate keys and normalization. If rows share a key, a row-index formulation must replace the unique-key version below.

definitions.R_s: Set of reference SNV keys for sample s, before the callable subset
definitions.E_s: Subset of R_s with final PTATO conclusion PASS or FAIL in that sample
definitions.G: Union over all samples t of E_t
definitions.L_s: R_s intersect G, the literal Figure2.R global-membership denominator for sample s
definitions.X_s: L_s minus E_s, the rows additionally admitted by cross-sample membership

global_membership_identity.identity: E_s is a subset of L_s; X_s = (R_s minus E_s) intersect (union over t not equal to s of E_t). Therefore |L_s| = |E_s| + |X_s|. The two denominators are identical if and only if X_s is empty.
global_membership_identity.row_index_generalization: For each reference row i in sample s with variant key v_i, literal selection is 1{v_i belongs to G}; local selection is 1{PTATO conclusion_i in PASS,FAIL}. The excess consists of locally ineligible rows whose key matches any eligible row anywhere. With duplicate keys the matching eligible row may belong to the same sample, so the distinct-sample expression requires the uniqueness assumption.
global_membership_identity.interpretation: The code's label 'callable' does not by itself establish sample-specific callable eligibility. This identity proves a possible difference in the selection rules. It does not show that any actual study row belongs to X_s.

constructed_membership_example.label: Constructed rule-equivalence check; not study data
constructed_membership_example.explanation: E_A={v}, E_B={w}, G={v,w}. L_B={v,w} and X_B={v}; the local B denominator is 1 and the literal global-membership B denominator is 2. For PTATO, B changes from 100% FAIL on E_B to 50% FAIL and 50% LOW_COV on L_B. For SCAN2 on the same chosen reference rows, B changes from 0/1 PASS to 1/2 PASS. Both are conditional descriptions, not independently calibrated sensitivity estimates.
constructed_membership_example.precedence_feasibility: B/v can be LOW_COV for PTATO and PASS for SCAN2 because the code assigns SCAN2 membership after LOW_COV. E_A makes B/v survive the later global join. This is an internally consistent constructed scenario, not an observed event.

assumptions: Fix one caller and one declared reference frame.
Let m be the number of sample groups with positive denominator n_s.
For category c, let n_sc be its row count and f_sc=n_sc/n_s. Let k_c be the number of sample groups with n_sc>0.

definitions.sparse_mean: For k_c>0, mean only over the k_c observed sample/category rows: a_c=(1/k_c) sum over s with n_sc>0 of f_sc
definitions.zero_completed_equal_sample_mean: z_c=(1/m) sum over all m groups of f_sc, explicitly including zero frequencies
definitions.pooled_fraction: p_c=(sum_s n_sc)/(sum_s n_s), which weights groups by their denominators

sparse_category_mean_identity.identity: For k_c>0, a_c=(m/k_c) z_c. If k_c=0, the sparse source table has no category row; z_c=0 but a_c is undefined. When every sample's categories form a complete partition, sum_c z_c=1 and sum_c p_c=1. Sum_c a_c can exceed 1 whenever a present category is absent in at least one group; equality requires every positive category to appear in all m groups.
sparse_category_mean_identity.boundary: The identity assumes the stated categories are retained as a partition. Factor conversion, missing keys or duplicate rows require separate auditing. Zero-denominator or omitted samples must be separately reported, not silently counted as zero-frequency groups. No binomial or independent-origin sampling law follows from this arithmetic.

constructed_mean_example.label: Constructed denominator check; not study data
constructed_mean_example.interpretation: One may display four total variant rows while averaging two sample frequencies. That display is not a pooled fraction and does not represent four independent biological trials.

label_and_interval_cautions.finding: PTATO applies FAIL_QC then LOW_COV after caller membership; SCAN2 applies caller PASS membership after those exclusions. In a truly local E_s subset, final PTATO PASS/FAIL already requires passing these common QC/callability rules, so this particular QC/coverage overwrite contrast is neutralized there. The global L_s subset need not neutralize it when X_s is nonempty.
SCAN2's membership set includes the loaded PASS and RESCUE rows; its comparison PASS category is not equivalent to the original pass=TRUE column alone.

PTA VAF<0.2 is flagged before high PTAprob can overwrite it with FAIL. Predecessor VAF must be strictly >0.2. Preserve threshold equality and missing-value behavior; do not describe both rules merely as a shared VAF cutoff.
FAIL_VAF is absent from the declared factor levels and can become factor NA after the original NA-to-ABSENT conversion. Count it before display conversion if present.

BED column 2 is passed directly to 1-based IRanges without increment. If the authentic file uses conventional zero-based half-open BED coordinates, this differs at interval starts. The actual convention and affected rows remain unverified. Preserve literal behavior for reproduction, and label any conventional-coordinate comparison separately.

All four PTA rows enter the code, including the FANCC Training=Yes branch; unique predecessor selection and the WT metadata/figure label reversal were already authenticated in R24. They are not new R25 evidence.

literal_replay_deliverables: Authenticated original inputs, exact source hashes, software/port identity and field parsing record.
Per-sample reference counts and exclusions; pre-display conclusion counts; original and final labels; Training status and both WT label schemes.
L_s and E_s counts, X_s category composition and every affected sample-key pairing retained externally.
For each category: contributing sample count k_c, common positive-denominator count m, literal sparse mean, explicit zero-completed mean and separately labelled pooled fraction.
Counts actually affected by precedence, threshold boundaries, missing fields, duplicate keys, BED endpoints and category factor conversion; zero counts remain legitimate findings.
Exact correspondence or explicitly bounded discrepancy with the claimed published statistic, without silently correcting the source semantics.

separate_eligibility_audit.purpose: Check how the conditional descriptive summary changes under an explicitly declared sample-specific PTATO PASS/FAIL reference frame and complete sample/category table.
rules: Use E_s rather than L_s for both callers within sample s.
Retain SCAN2 imported pass/RESCUE state and raw QC/callability as distinct columns; state the chosen final PASS definition.
Complete zero category counts for every admitted sample with a positive denominator before calculating equal-sample descriptive means.
Audit duplicates, missing values, interval conventions and training status before interpreting results.
separate_eligibility_audit.boundary: This is a different descriptive calculation, not an unannounced repair of the original analysis, an independent genotype truth set, an unbiased comparison of callers, or a native-origin benchmark. E_s is itself selected using PTATO outcomes.

scientific_boundary: Inherited/standing variants, dropout, reference/copy state, repair differences, selection, drift, lineage loss and technical ascertainment remain conventional explanations. No authentic independent origin truth, native event inclusion, mutation-production rate, TMD biological fit or cancer-prevention claim follows. Actual 26-field and planning 18-field NULL registries, forecasts/eta, count laws, error allocation, stopping rules, provider pause and the immutable 1 October Zenodo 0.6.0 release remain unchanged.
